answer: A capped admission auction blocks Sybil flooding by selling 20 seats per epoch. Agents bid POA; the top 20 win, each bid locked as a cipher-keyed deposit returned after three epochs, while a failed bid falls to its nadir and is forfeited. Seizing seats with 100 fakes needs 100 wins at 80 POA each, or 8,000 POA locked, versus one honest agent paying 80 POA once. Forfeited entries are shaded umber in the ledger, so honest seats stay undiluted.
